Question B-006-010-010.

Why the correct answer is right: A loading coil supplies inductive reactance to cancel the capacitive reactance of a short HF mobile vertical.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "To tune out capacitive reactance": Correct. A loading coil supplies inductive reactance to cancel the capacitive reactance of a short HF mobile vertical.
- sourceIndex 1: "To lower the losses": A loading coil is mainly there to tune out capacitive reactance in a short antenna.
- sourceIndex 2: "To lower the Q": A loading coil is mainly there to tune out capacitive reactance in a short antenna.
- sourceIndex 3: "To filter out electrical noise": Those are different performance topics; feed-point matching reduces high-SWR feedline loss.
